svg.aria-label: Affine Registration: Shift and Dilation of Time
svg.title: Affine Registration: Shift and Dilation of Time
svg.desc: Affine registration warps time linearly, h(t) = a t + b; the registered curve is g(s) = f((s minus b)/a), dilation about t = 0. A coarse grid over the bounded (a, b) box is refined by box-projected Nelder-Mead; the criterion is integrated over the full domain or only the overlap.
svg.text: Affine Registration: Shift and Dilation of Time
Linear warp h(t) = a·t + b per curve; registered g(s) = f((s − b) / a)
